title: Common-stage models of two finite affine etale free families
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder and $D:I^{op}\to\mathrm{Scheme}$ an inverse system of qcqs schemes with affine transitions, with limit cone $(X,\pi)$ [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], [pqf-def-affine-morphism]. Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring and let $U_1,\ldots,U_n$, $V_1,\ldots,V_m$ be two finite families of affine etale objects of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let $P_X(Z)$ be the sheafification of $T\mapsto\Lambda[\mathrm{Hom}_X(T,Z)]$ [lem-weil-pbc-free-yoneda-presheaf-module], [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Then there exist a stage $i$ and affine etale objects $W^U_k,W^V_l$ of $D_i$ such that, writing $Q_i(W)=j_{W!}\underline\Lambda_W$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension], [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], there are isomorphisms $\pi_i^{-1}(\bigoplus_k Q_i(W^U_k))\cong\bigoplus_kP_X(U_k)$ and $\pi_i^{-1}(\bigoplus_lQ_i(W^V_l))\cong\bigoplus_lP_X(V_l)$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Empty families are permitted. No assertion about morphisms between the two sums is made.

source.place: Tag 09YU (3), proof via the fully faithful and essentially surjective arguments and Tag 095N; verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09YU.

proof.text: Extract the base-change functors T, v, their cartesian projection squares, their delta comparisons and the essential-surjectivity clause from exists_affineEtaleSite_colimit. Apply the latter to the combined finite family indexed by Fin n plus Fin m. Choose one upper bound for the finite image of its stage-index function, using Finset.exists_le. Move each model to that stage using T. Delta followed by the original descent isomorphism gives a full-affine-site isomorphism to the original object.

The cartesian square for v identifies the canonical pullback of each common-stage model with v applied to it. Compose with the isomorphism from step 1 and apply the inclusion of the full affine etale site to obtain eW. Prove that the sheafified free presheaf and j_! of the constant rank-one module each represent sections, exposing shriekEvalEquiv and its naturality shriekEvalEquiv_comp for reuse by the eventual-Hom-lift module: use sheafification, free-module, constant-sheaf and shriek adjunctions and ulift Yoneda. Prove naturality and compare each to Sheaf.freeYoneda by Coyoneda.ext. Apply the source-library upperStarFreeYonedaIso and freeYonedaMapIso to eW. This gives the comparison of each summand.

Use PreservesCoproduct.iso for inverse image, which is a left adjoint, followed by Sigma.mapIso of the summand comparisons. Restrict the combined family to each side of Fin n plus Fin m. Its models belong to the full affine etale subcategory, hence their domains are affine. Nonemptiness supplies a stage even when both families are empty.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affine_free_etaleModule_family_models
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (n m : ℕ) (U : Fin n → c.pt.Etale) (V : Fin m → c.pt.Etale)
    (hU : ∀ k : Fin n, IsAffine (U k).left)
    (hV : ∀ k : Fin m, IsAffine (V k).left) :
    let P : c.pt.Etale → Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) :=
      fun W ↦ (presheafToSheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj
        (uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj W ⋙ ModuleCat.free Λ)
    ∃ (i : I) (WU : Fin n → (D.obj (op i)).Etale)
      (WV : Fin m → (D.obj (op i)).Etale),
      let Q : (D.obj (op i)).Etale →
          Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) :=
        fun W ↦ (Etale.etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) W.hom inferInstance).obj
          ((constantSheaf W.left.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj
            (ModuleCat.of Λ Λ))
      (∀ k, IsAffine (WU k).left) ∧ (∀ k, IsAffine (WV k).left) ∧
      Nonempty ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (c.π.app (op i))).obj
        (∐ fun k : Fin n ↦ Q (WU k)) ≅ (∐ fun k : Fin n ↦ P (U k))) ∧
      Nonempty ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (c.π.app (op i))).obj
        (∐ fun k : Fin m ↦ Q (WV k)) ≅ (∐ fun k : Fin m ↦ P (V k)))
